baseline_strategy.claim_boundary: Window priority controls acquisition order only. It does not imply that pre-2015 literature is scientifically less important.

query_families.label: Neural interfaces and brain-computer interfaces
query_families.rationale: Captures direct neural input/output systems and neuroprosthetic interfaces.

query_families.label: Neural decoding and encoding
query_families.rationale: Captures computational inference from or prediction of neural signals.

query_families.label: Closed-loop and adaptive neuromodulation
query_families.rationale: Captures sensing-to-control neurotechnology with adaptive or responsive intervention.

query_families.label: Machine learning for neural data
query_families.rationale: Captures ML systems materially operating on neural measurements.

query_families.label: Non-invasive neural sensing and decoding
query_families.rationale: Captures non-invasive neural-measurement systems where decoding is a central method.

query_families.label: Neural datasets and benchmarks
query_families.rationale: Captures public data and benchmarking infrastructure relevant to model and system evidence.

candidate_inclusion.discovery_rule: A provider record enters candidate state when it matches at least one frozen query family under that provider's deterministic query compilation.

authority_boundary: This protocol defines discovery and acquisition scope. Candidate retrieval, counts, citations, venue, or prominence establish no scientific truth, relevance adjudication, system conformance, or institutional authority.
